name: Cursor looks
description: The pointer of a screen recording in one of eight playful looks: Glass, Comet, Ink, Caption, Pointer stick, Pixel, Plasma or Glassmorph. Each look has its own move, hover, text, drag and wait state, and presses and bursts on every click.
when: Screen demos that should feel fun or on brand: launches, social clips, tutorials. Needs a screen take recorded with the cursor log (take-NN-screen.events.json).
needs: a cut that shows a screen take (kind: screen)
the take's cursor log: get_session shows it as events under the screen take
which look (ask if the user did not say), and optional colour and size
the edit's size and frame.crop, if any
